# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-304#show-one-ci-proof-row-per-location

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision.** SEED-304#show-one-ci-proof-row-per-location (`.planning/seeds/SEED-304-ci-proof-one-row-per-location.md#show-one-ci-proof-row-per-location`), plan `.planning/slice-plans/582-show-one-ci-proof-row-per-location/PLAN.md`, revision `04d85ceec8e3dbc6fbe285355e34d99daf134c96`. Isolated detached scratch worktree at `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-304-show-one-ci-proof-row-per-location-scratch` (pre-probe: clean product tree at that HEAD; only `?? node_modules` symlink to the execution checkout; execution checkout unused for edits).
- **Promise.** Key example 1 / outside-in proof map: one location row keeps both result types' labeled figures — including an explicit file failure beside passing cases — so dropping a type cannot satisfy a one-row-only check.
- **Fault.** In `dashboard/src/ciProofEntryCells.ts` (`entryProofCellsOf`), replaced `entry.evidence.map(...)` with `entry.evidence.slice(0, 1).map(...)`, so a mixed-unit location still yields one row but loses every unit after the first. Fixture and assertions stayed unchanged.
- **Existing protection.** Focused command, unchanged for baseline, fault, and restoration:
  `caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard -- dashboard/tests/intent/intent-ci-proof-grouped-location.spec.ts --workers=1`
  with `OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_PROOF_RECORD` at `/tmp/seed304-ic-baseline.json`, `/tmp/seed304-ic-fault.json`, and `/tmp/seed304-ic-restored.json`. Selected test: `one location row keeps each result type's shard totals, empty reports, file failure beside cases, and a typed timing gap` (`dashboard/tests/intent/intent-ci-proof-grouped-location.spec.ts:100`). Intended assertion path: `expectProofRows` → `expectProofCell` at `dashboard/tests/intentCiProofPage.ts:110`, expecting two `.intent-ci-proof-unit-line` labels on the first location's Counts cell (`test cases: 2542 passed test cases` and `test files: no test files`); the same row contract later names `with-failure`'s `test files: 1 failed test file`.
- **Runs.** AC power; `caffeinate -s -i`. Proof-record `selectedCount` was 1 on every run.
  - Baseline: strict passed; runner 5687.446 ms; attempt 2494 ms.
  - Fault: strict failed; runner 8042.324 ms; attempt 7187 ms. Failure reached `expectProofCell` for `frontend/tests` Counts: expected 2 labeled unit lines, received 0 (the single remaining unit took the flat single-unit cell path). That is wrong behavior on the intended multi-type labeled-figures path; the later `with-failure` file-failure lines were not reached because this earlier Counts assertion failed first.
  - Restored: exact original SHA-256 `adf4d1416d93d245758e420c2b32346eef0934950bb8e36ef51a099bbe5e7037` restored; `git status --porcelain` matched pre-probe (`?? node_modules` only); HEAD remained `04d85ceec8e3dbc6fbe285355e34d99daf134c96`; same focused command strict passed; runner 2812.772 ms; attempt 2022 ms. Owned scratch worktree then removed; execution checkout product paths were never modified by this probe.
- **Finding.** **Caught.** Dropping every unit after the first removes both types' labeled figures from a one-row location (including the file-failure-beside-cases case), and the maintained grouped-location assertion fails on the intended Counts unit-line count.

- **Test runtime.** Measured from the maintained dashboard proof recorder `terminal.durationMs` / attempt `durationMs`: baseline 5687.446 ms (attempt 2494 ms); fault 8042.324 ms (attempt 7187 ms); restored 2812.772 ms (attempt 2022 ms).
